purpose: Personalised dysarthric automatic speech recognition for user-controlled communication, not clinical diagnosis

candidates.role: General-purpose multilingual ASR baseline; check current license/runtime requirements
Research comparator only; model card does not establish generalisability or provenance of underlying training examples

development_stages.action: Record baseline WER, CER and keyword error rates on approved CP-specific held-out speakers
Train a pooled adapter on rights-approved dysarthric speech, keep typical-speech replay set
Personalise per speaker with opt-in encrypted adapter or lexicon, hold out subsequent sessions
Evaluate real-world voice commands, spontaneous conversation, fatigue and microphone shifts
Pilot with disabled co-designers and speech-language pathologists before any production claims

split_strategy.population: speaker-disjoint train/dev/test; stratify on consented clinical and language labels
split_strategy.personalisation: per-participant earlier-session enrolment vs later unseen personal_test

promotion_gates: No raw participant audio in public Git repositories
Signed or recorded consent for specific uses, rights reviewed
Performance stratified by speaker and meaningful access contexts
Baseline comparison and prospective evaluation complete
note: No weights have been trained, no external speech recordings imported, no model has been evaluated in this repository.
